warmup.description: Gradually raise heart rate and prepare joints for explosive, full-body movement.

main_exercises.name: Round 1: 40s work / 20s rest x 4 rounds
main_exercises.load_guidance: Bodyweight; aim for near max effort while maintaining good form
main_exercises.form_cue: Move explosively but stay controlled, especially during landings.

main_exercises.name: Round 2: 30s work / 15s rest x 4 rounds
main_exercises.load_guidance: Bodyweight; aim for consistent high output across all rounds
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep transitions quick and maintain intensity through fatigue.

main_exercises.name: Finisher: 20s work / 10s rest (Tabata style)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Max effort; push close to your limit while staying safe
main_exercises.form_cue: Focus on speed and intensity, maintaining form despite fatigue.

cooldown.description: Lower heart rate and release tension in major muscle groups.
movements: Standing quad stretch x 45s per side
Deep breathing in seated position x 60s

phase_notes.menstrual: This session is not recommended in this phase due to its high intensity and impact. Consider a lower intensity or recovery-focused session instead.
phase_notes.follicular: Great time to push intensity—aim for explosive movement and consistent output across rounds. You may find recovery between intervals feels quicker.
phase_notes.ovulatory: Peak energy and power make this session ideal—maximize speed and effort, especially in jumps and sprints, while maintaining strong form.
phase_notes.early_luteal: You can still perform well here—focus on maintaining intensity but be mindful of fatigue creeping in during later rounds.
phase_notes.late_luteal: This session may feel overly taxing—consider shortening rounds or reducing intensity to avoid excessive fatigue and stress.
